entities.summary: Igor Dmitriyevich Spassky was a Soviet and Russian scientist, engineer and entrepreneur. General Designer of nearly 200 Soviet and Russian nuclear submarines, and the head of the Central Design Bureau for Marine Engineering Rubin.
